intro: Nothing fancy — just what we actually do.

items.text: Coffee we roast ourselves from importers we can name; every batch logged
Regional eggs and dairy when the supply chain cooperates
Whole, oat, and 2% milk — allergens posted at the counter daily
Discount for reusable cups; spent grounds free for local gardens
Open jobs posted in-shop before they go online
Roasting scheduled off-peak to lighten the load on the grid
